recommendations.text: Hemodynamic assessment and resuscitation should be initiated immediately

For GI Bleeding Assessment, the following actions are mandatory: - assess vital signs - assess hemodynamic status - order lab cbc - order lab coagulation - order lab type and crossmatch - establish iv access (within 15 minutes)
NSAIDs and anticoagulants worsen variceal bleeding in cirrhosis. [FORBIDDEN: give_nsaid, give_aspirin, give_anticoagulation] (Severity: CRITICAL)
Hemodynamic instability requires immediate resuscitation before endoscopy. [REQUIRED: establish_large_bore_iv, give_crystalloid_bolus, type_and_crossmatch] (Severity: CRITICAL)

Hemodynamic resuscitation must precede endoscopy in unstable GI bleeding; oral fluids are insufficient for hemorrhagic shock. [FORBIDDEN: delay_resuscitation_for_endoscopy_in_gi_bleed, give_oral_fluids_only_in_gi_hemorrhagic_shock] (Severity: HIGH)
recommendations.source_guideline: ACG GI Bleeding 2023; hemodynamic resuscitation takes priority over endoscopy in unstable patients

recommendations.text: Supratherapeutic INR with active bleeding requires urgent reversal. [REQUIRED: give_pcc, give_vitamin_k] (Severity: HIGH)
Variceal bleeding requires octreotide and prophylactic antibiotics. [REQUIRED: give_octreotide, give_prophylactic_antibiotics] (Severity: HIGH)
Platelets <50k with active bleeding require transfusion before endoscopy. [REQUIRED: transfuse_platelets] (Severity: HIGH)

Active GI bleeding with thrombocytopenia requires platelet transfusion; aspirin in this setting worsens hemorrhage. [FORBIDDEN: delay_platelet_transfusion_in_active_bleed, give_aspirin_in_severe_thrombocytopenia] (Severity: HIGH)
recommendations.source_guideline: ACG GI Bleeding 2023; platelet count < 50k with active bleeding requires transfusion; antiplatelet agents worsen bleeding

recommendations.text: Mechanical valve patients need bridging; cannot hold anticoagulation indefinitely. [FORBIDDEN: stop_anticoagulation_indefinitely, withhold_anticoagulation_without_bridge] (Severity: CRITICAL)
NSAID-associated GI bleed despite PPI: NSAID must be discontinued. [FORBIDDEN: continue_nsaid, give_nsaid, restart_nsaid_without_ppi] (Severity: HIGH)
recommendations.source_guideline: ACG GI Bleeding 2023; Lanza FL, Am J Gastroenterol 2009

recommendations.text: Hemodynamically unstable patients must be resuscitated before endoscopy. [FORBIDDEN: proceed_to_endoscopy_without_resuscitation, delay_transfusion_for_endoscopy] (Severity: CRITICAL)
Do not delay resuscitation to perform endoscopy in hemodynamically unstable patients
For Hemodynamically Unstable GI Bleed, the following actions are mandatory: - give iv crystalloid bolus (within 15 minutes) - give packed rbc if hgb below 7 - consult gi - consult surgery
During Hemodynamically Unstable GI Bleed, the following actions are contraindicated and must NOT be performed: delay resuscitation for endoscopy.
